# Comet Native

Native 在项目中保存需求和验收结论。先确认 change 的运行格式，再执行当前动作。

旧 SDK Action 继续使用响应中的 `claimRequest` 模板领取，保留原 Run 和执行身份。

## 必须遵守的规则

- 已确认范围内的实现、文档修复、证据复用和恢复连续推进；只在需要新决定、授权或外部信息时暂停。使用最新 continuation 的命令、模板和任务包，修正输入后沿用当前任务。
- SDK 的推进以 Runtime Run 为准，当前 change 的 `comet-state.yaml` 用于边界恢复；旧 Runtime 继续使用其状态文件。读取实际配置和正式文件，聊天记忆只作辅助。Agent 编辑 brief、新能力或旧格式的完整目标 Spec、关联能力的 `delta.yaml` 和 `children.yaml`；关联能力的完整目标 Spec 由 Runtime 在 Shape 确认前生成。业务状态、用户批准、检查报告和事务由 Runtime 保存；普通检查由 Agent 使用平台工具执行。
- 通过 PATH 中公开的 `comet native` 命令推进，用户不手工执行命令。命令不可用时报告安装不完整并停止；参数以 `comet native <command> --help` 为准。
- 新建 change 走 CLI 并使用响应路径；拒绝后按信息中的命令或目标修正并重试；自定义 Hook、非 Comet 工作和普通同名文件保持中立。
- Builder 提交本轮待验收的代码和相关文件，称为“候选实现”。Verify 覆盖全部验收项，复用仍与当前候选匹配的检查，只补缺失或失效证据。当前 Action 的 `sessionRequirements.independent` 为 `false` 时，由当前 Agent 根据不确定性和用户要求决定是否另请只读 Verifier；为 `true` 时使用独立会话。失败、阻塞、未执行和超时不能算通过。
- 只有用户明确确认完整 Shape、接受最终结果或选择相应交付方式后，才执行对应的确认命令。沿用已确认的需求范围和 Runtime 保存的用户选择。归档、merge、push、PR 和工作区清理各自需要的授权不能互相代替。
- Native 主流程由本 Skill 和 Runtime 完成，不依赖外部 Skill；不改变已确认的需求和约束时，实现方法由 Agent 自行选择。

## 开始或恢复

首次开始任务或更换 Agent 平台时，核对公开 CLI 和结果回报能力。当前 Action 要求独立会话时，再读取[平台能力核对](../comet/reference/host-check.md)并安排执行者。

1. 当前响应已包含工作区、任务和下一步时直接继续。缺少这些信息时，已知名称运行 `comet native select <change-name> --json`，否则运行 `comet native status --json`。active change 已存在时进入 `workspace.projectRoot`；工作区有歧义时才让用户选择。Run 记录丢失时读取[故障恢复](reference/recovery.md#故障恢复)。
2. 没有对应 active change 时，按[工作区选择参考](reference/workspace.md#创建-change)确定隔离方式，运行 `native new`，用 `--task` 传入用户原始请求，不先改写成方案摘要，再进入 `preparation.projectRoot`。准备失败时，保留已创建的分支和目录，按返回的原因处理。
3. 进入工作区并取得 `phase` 后，按[记忆接入](reference/commands.md#记忆接入)获取适用上下文。进入新阶段、交接给新 Agent 或恢复上下文时，由接收方执行 `contextRequest`，重新取得当前适用偏好和项目约束；同一阶段连续执行无需重复获取。任务结束时按该节分别处理项目记忆和个人记忆，再调用 `comet task --complete`。

仅在出现明确的用户纠正、长期记忆要求或已验证的可复用经验时提交学习内容。普通收尾无需调用工具证明没有观察，也无需清空学习队列。任务摘要、进展、命令输出和测试结果不写入个人记忆。

项目经验与个人偏好分开保存：可由当前项目验证、且未来任务仍可复用的经验在任务结束前执行 `comet knowledge remember` 写入项目记忆；用户偏好和稳定协作习惯才进入个人记忆。两者的命令和完成条件见[记忆接入](reference/commands.md#记忆接入)。

## SDK Run 路径

先读取并执行[普通命令与检查](../comet/reference/platform-execution.md)。旧业务数据自动适配，沿用原 Run 和有效批准。普通任务和 Supervisor 任务使用 `native next <change> --session <真实会话标识> --json` 领取。Shape 中由 Agent 提取验收条目并提交，等待用户明确确认后进入 Build。响应 `comet.native.task-result.v1` 给出阶段、实际工作区、验收正文、结果模板和下一步，直接照此执行。多个任务可领取时，从 `availableTasks` 选择真实执行范围，并用其 Action 和实际会话领取；按 `task.child`、`task.scope` 和工作区完成当前任务。

1. Builder 完成实现后，将 `resultTemplate` 的实际业务结果写入临时 UTF-8 JSON，用返回的 `next.commandArgs` 提交。保留命令中的 `--action` 和真实 `--session`。Agent 使用平台工具运行必要检查，等待真实结果，并在 checks 的 name/result/note 中记录命令、目录、结果和日志引用。Builder 一次回报实现与检查；Verifier 的 output.checks 填写本次采信的实际结果。失败、未运行和未知结果不能算通过，不提交 verificationChecks、request-checks 或自制收据。旧检查调度不再执行，使用当前返回的业务模板。当前会话继续验收时使用 `--review current-session`，另请审查者时使用 `--review independent`，由接收者以自己的真实会话领取。
2. Verify 覆盖全部验收项，复用有效检查，只补缺失证据；提交实际结论后，Runtime 返回用户接受结果的步骤。用户明确要求独立审查时必须选择独立会话。
3. 只有用户事前明确委托“验收通过后接受并归档”时，才在本次 Verify 回报中加 `--accept-on-pass <用户授权摘要>`。该摘要绑定本次通过结果。其他情况等待用户接受，再执行返回的确认命令。Git 交付仍使用已有的对应授权。

新建内置任务无需读取底层协议。并行子任务只在各自 worktree 工作并返回结果；主 Agent 按原 Action、真实子会话和领取身份顺序提交，保留原 `resultTemplate` 或 `resultRequest`，不重新领取或改用主会话。Supervisor 回报后，Runtime 连续处理 Git 集成和子归档；接收下一个子任务需使用其真实执行会话。父级验收保留全部要求，复用适用的子结果并补足集成缺口。当前响应为旧 `comet.native.sdk-status.v1`、`comet.native.dispatch-result.v1`、`comet.native.run-view.v1`，且高层入口不适用，或属于固定应用时，读取[SDK Run 命令与恢复](reference/commands.md#sdk-run)。完整协议需要时用 `--details`，不额外查询 status 来识别已有响应。

两种 Runtime 均使用最新 `continuation`；`--runner-input` 和旧 Archive 输入仅用于旧 Runtime。SDK 路径遵守用户确认、当前 Action 的验收要求和工作区授权。已知旧 change 在入口自动适配业务数据，不恢复旧进程或重播外部操作。

## 按需读取

只读取当前动作对应的章节。章节中的链接写明了适用条件，满足条件时再读取链接内容；不一次加载整份命令参考或所有参考。

- Shape：必须读取并执行[澄清](reference/clarification.md#澄清)，按项目配置选择 Sequential 或 Batch 的提问步骤。大型需求在最终确认前，必须按该节链接读取 Supervisor 拆分与确认要求。
- 编辑 brief/Spec/`children.yaml` 或核对验收报告前，必须读取[正式产物](reference/artifacts.md#正式产物)。文件、附件、链接或本地路径作为需求来源时，必须进入[源文档完整覆盖模式](reference/artifacts.md#源文档完整覆盖)；仅用于排错、取证、审查或实现参考的材料不自动触发。
- 高层任务响应缺少所需字段，或使用旧 SDK、固定应用时，读取[平台 Action 协议](reference/commands.md#sdk-action-领取与回报)、[SDK Builder 交接](reference/commands.md#sdk-builder-交接)或[SDK Verify 协议](reference/commands.md#sdk-verify-协议)中当前需要的章节。
- Compat 首次填写 Runner 模板或通过 `returnAction` 回传前，读取[填写命令输入](reference/commands.md#填写命令输入)，再按阶段读取[Builder 交接](reference/commands.md#builder-交接)或[Verify 协议](reference/commands.md#verify-协议)。
- 状态包含 `childSummary` 时，必须在分配任务、接收结果或集成前读取[Supervisor 协作](reference/commands.md#supervisor-协作)，只处理 `readyChildren` 列出的子任务和 Supervisor 统筹动作。
- 字段含义不清、命令输入被拒绝、Verifier 不可用、执行错误或缺少外部信息：读取[命令输入与异常](reference/commands.md#命令输入与异常)。正常动作直接使用 Runtime 返回的命令和模板。
- 等待外部输入时，按恢复参考中的[等待外部输入与监控](reference/recovery.md#等待外部输入与监控)处理；独立工作继续。进程中断、换设备、连续无进展、并发冲突、迁移失败或状态损坏时，读取[故障恢复](reference/recovery.md#故障恢复)。

## Shape

Agent 先调查能够查明的事实，只询问会改变用户可见结果、又无法可靠推断的决定。简单问题列出未决项及其依赖关系；多个决定相互影响时才建立决策树。按 `native.clarification_mode` 提问前，先把本轮尚未解决的问题写入 brief。用户确认的结论立即同步到 brief 的相关章节和完整目标规格；未明确回答的部分保持 `[blocking]`。

把用户明确指定的文件位置、必需章节和产物格式写入 brief 的约束，按原要求准备这些内容；不能因模板默认位置而改放其他文件。交接和恢复时以这些已确认约束核对产物，不能只保留业务示例。

写完 Shape 后，回到原始请求和公开项目资料核对目标、验收项与非目标。把实现必需的行为列为非目标前，先说明它会怎样改变用户要求；有多种解释时，写清依据和影响，不把自行选择的解释当作用户已确认的要求。固定评估任务中的模拟批准不能修改原题。

完成标准：需求来源已在用户指定的覆盖边界内完整处理并按用途分类，所有影响结果的决定和假设已处理，没有 `[blocking]`，用户明确确认目标、范围、关键决定、全部验收项和非目标，并且 Runtime 已进入 Build。

新建需求或重新确认 Shape 时，由 Agent 判断目标、范围、非目标、验收和必要 Spec 是否充分，按任务需要组织文档。Runtime 保留正式路径、非空输入、机器结构和用户确认检查。新建普通 SDK Run 可通过 `next --session` 提交明确验收条目，不要求为解析器改写文档。

Build、Verify 或待归档阶段发生编辑时，按[编辑后续行](reference/edit-review.md)由当前 Agent 判断影响，沿用原 Run 和有效批准，只补必要检查。文件变化不自动作废验收，不提交指纹、hash 或编辑复核记录。修订命令不构成用户授权；缺授权时只请求受影响的决定。

## Build ↔ Verify Loop

Builder 完成实现并用平台工具执行检查后，一次提交候选与实际结果，再由领取 Verify Action 的 Agent 完成验收。未通过则回 Build 修复并重新提交；全部通过后，等待用户接受验收结果。

Verifier 先读原始请求，再对照 Spec 和实现，核对有无遗漏、未经授权的范围缩减或接口行为变化。SDK Run 使用同一份验收结果中的 `requestReview` 说明结论；有冲突或仍影响交付的疑问时，保留 fail 或 blocked。旧 Run 和 Compat 没有保存原始请求时，从交接材料和用户记录补查，不把新生成的 Spec 当成唯一需求来源；Compat 沿用原结果结构。语义核对沿用当前 Verifier，不增加 Agent 或固定测试轮次。

`iteration` 表示提交实现的轮次，`attempt` 表示同一候选的 Verifier 执行次数。Runtime 保留真实失败次数预算和执行上限；Agent 根据实际修改和结果判断进展。未解决验收项 ID 相同或集合未缩小，不触发额外提示、暂停或重新确认。

## Build

首次实现前，读取当前 brief、完整目标规格和全部验收项，在已确认的需求范围内修改项目代码和测试。修复时优先处理 Verifier 指出的未通过项、无法验证的原因和失败检查；提交前仍要核对其他已确认行为。`previous_unresolved_ids` 只提示本轮修复重点，下一次正式验收仍覆盖全部验收项。

Build、Verify 和 Archive 由 Agent 对照实际文件和用户要求判断变化，不以内容摘要决定批准或验收是否失效。需求未变则保留批准，目标、验收标准或授权发生实质变化且原决定未覆盖时才重新确认。正式产物位置和阶段权限见[正式产物](reference/artifacts.md#正式产物)。

用户 Hook 的共享输出目录可通过 `.comet/config.yaml` 的 `hook.allow_paths` 放行；该配置对 Native 和 Classic 共用，工作流产物目录不在白名单范围。详见[用户 Hook 写入](reference/commands.md#用户-hook-写入)。

需求变化时，先判断变化属于哪种情况，再执行当前 `continuation` 允许的动作：

- 已确认的功能有实现遗漏：从 Verify 使用 `--revise-implementation`，保留已确认的需求范围，回 Build 修改。
- 用户可见行为或验收标准发生变化：从 Verify 或 Archive-ready 使用 `--revise-requirements`，更新正式文件，按[需求变化后的重新确认](reference/clarification.md#需求变化后的重新确认)先说明变化与影响，再展示完整当前 Shape 并重新确认。
- 与当前需求无关：交给另一个 change。

用户明确补充当前范围时，按同一规则处理。

用户确认一次 Supervisor Shape，就授权执行该范围内的全部子任务。按 Runtime 的指令分配和集成子任务，随后自动进行 Supervisor 主任务的最终验收，覆盖全部验收项。按[Supervisor 协作](reference/commands.md#supervisor-协作)区分统筹、Builder 和 Verifier 的职责；只有 Runtime 接受了子任务的验收结果并确认集成成功，才算完成。

提交候选前，按 brief 中登记的原位置检查文件、章节和格式，补齐遗漏产物；可自动检查的要求列入本轮平台检查，检查实际内容，不能只检查另一个文件中存在同类内容。修改已批准正式内容时沿用现有修订和确认流程。

完成标准：实现和相关检查可供验收，Runtime 接受 Builder 交接并进入 Verify。

## Verify

新 SDK 普通任务按当前 `task` 和 `resultTemplate` 完成验收；Builder 回报已包含内部检查与领取时，直接继续本次任务。旧 SDK 按 [SDK Verify 协议](reference/commands.md#sdk-verify-协议) 与 `sessionRequirements.independent` 领取，优先使用 `resultRequest`，缺少时使用 `outcomeRequest`。所有执行者使用真实会话身份。

Compat 按 [Verify 协议](reference/commands.md#verify-协议) 立即启动新的只读 Verifier，原样传递任务包。派发只代表登记：平台接受启动调用、且 Verifier 回报 `verifier-started` 后，才说明它已运行；启动失败立即按异常流程处理。任务包含验收正文时直接使用，否则按分页读取全部 scopeIds。

Verifier 独立判断全部验收项，同时核对 brief 中登记的产物位置、必需章节和格式，不能用另一文件中的同类内容代替；缺项或错位时报告实际差异，不能给当前候选通过结论。由验收者判断已有真实检查是否仍适用，只补必要证据；新旧 Run 均通过平台工具执行检查；文件和日志正文按需读取。等待工具超时后，继续等待同一个 Verifier。只有平台确认执行失败、超时、任务丢失或结束后无结果时才登记错误。Runtime 接受完整结果后按最新状态继续。

用户明确接受当前结果后执行 `--accept-result`。用户事前明确委托通过后接受并归档时，按上文使用带授权摘要的 `--accept-on-pass`；fail、blocked 和执行失败均不能触发接受。Compat 的接受与交付方式仍按当前备选命令处理。

完成标准：Runtime 接受每项验收结论并给出下一步；返回 Build 就继续修复，返回等待或阻塞就处理对应条件，不把阶段结束当任务完成。

## Archive

SDK 接受结果后由 Runtime 连续完成归档。响应已说明归档完成时直接核对用户授权的 Git 交付；返回 Archive 命令时执行该命令。只有 Compat 收尾、工作区交付选择或具体恢复要求不清时，才读取[Archive 收尾](reference/workspace.md#archive-收尾)。只处理当前响应列出的阻塞。

只提交本 change 的实现和正式产物，保留无关修改。Compat 检查 `workspaceFinishResult`，阻塞时按 `recoveryArgs` 保留现场并恢复；SDK 以 Run 与实际 Git 结果分别核对归档和交付。已有授权足以处理的提交说明和本地阻塞由 Agent 修复后继续，不要求用户再次说“重试”；需要新增授权或外部信息时才询问。

完成标准：状态为 `done`；SDK Run 为 `completed` 且用户授权的 Git 交付已实际完成并核对，Compat 工作区收尾为 `completed` 或 `kept`；随后按记忆接入协议记录任务完成。其他结果继续处理。

## 后续指令

响应带有 `continuation.mode` 时，以它决定当前动作：`execute` 使用返回的完整参数、输入模板和任务包；`wait` 等待原任务；`ask` 展示当前提案并等待用户决定；`reconcile` 按返回证据核对原执行或处理阻塞；`done` 核对本次完成或取消的条件后结束。`commandArgs` 中的占位值必须按 `requiredInputs` 和输入模板填写，不能把模板当成已经完成的输入或用户批准。`inputRef` 指向同一响应内的完整输入，直接读取，不另查状态。每次写入后只使用新响应的身份、版本和工作目录；需要详情时执行同一响应给出的读取命令，不为寻找下一步再查询。

旧响应没有 `mode` 时，按原 `disposition` 继续：

- `continue`：在返回的工作目录执行完整 `commandArgs`，按 `inputOptions` 模板填写输入。
- `await-user`：先转述 `userCommunication.message` 和 `suggestedReply`，等待列出的决定；按用户选择执行 `commandAlternatives`，保留 `--expected-state-version` 和 `--expected-action`。过期时读取最新状态，不自行拼接无保护命令。
- `blocked`：处理列出的阻塞或恢复动作；仅暂停依赖该条件的工作。
- `done`：核对 Archive 完成标准后结束。

命令成功且响应包含 `agent` 时，直接复用共用 workflow guard 的轻量所有权读取结果和 `continuation` 继续。只在字段缺失、命令因版本或所有权被拒绝，或需要额外正文时读取详情；新会话或上下文压缩恢复缺少响应状态、仓库/分支/change 切换或有明确外部变化迹象时，才重新查询 `status`。不因等待工具超时重复派发已有的 Verifier 或子任务。

当前动作需要验收文字、交接摘要或历史详情时，才加 `--details`，并按 `nextPageArgs` 读取 `scopeIds` 涉及的全部页面。需要正式文件的正文时，才运行 `show`。阅读 CLI 文本时，先看 `summary`、唯一的 `NEXT:` 和可选转述消息；程序解析使用 `--json`，排查本机执行状态时才用 `--verbose`。

## 可选变更说明

Native 仅在用户要求可视化变更说明时生成 `walkthrough.html`。项目 `change_walkthrough` 默认开启，显式 `false` 时跳过；允许生成且用户需要时读取[变更说明](../comet/reference/change-walkthrough.md)，复用已有差异和结果，生成或更新同一页面并给出链接。普通收尾直接提供简短摘要。Archive 保存已有页面并提供实际归档链接，不补生成、不新增确认、不为页面更新重跑代码检查。

# Comet Native

Native 在项目中保存需求和验收结论。先确认 change 的运行格式，再执行当前动作。

旧 SDK Action 继续使用响应中的 `claimRequest` 模板领取，保留原 Run 和执行身份。

## 必须遵守的规则

- 已确认范围内的实现、文档修复、证据复用和恢复连续推进；只在需要新决定、授权或外部信息时暂停。使用最新 continuation 的命令、模板和任务包，修正输入后沿用当前任务。
- SDK 的推进以 Runtime Run 为准，当前 change 的 `comet-state.yaml` 用于边界恢复；旧 Runtime 继续使用其状态文件。读取实际配置和正式文件，聊天记忆只作辅助。Agent 编辑 brief、新能力或旧格式的完整目标 Spec、关联能力的 `delta.yaml` 和 `children.yaml`；关联能力的完整目标 Spec 由 Runtime 在 Shape 确认前生成。业务状态、用户批准、检查报告和事务由 Runtime 保存；普通检查由 Agent 使用平台工具执行。
- 通过 PATH 中公开的 `comet native` 命令推进，用户不手工执行命令。命令不可用时报告安装不完整并停止；参数以 `comet native <command> --help` 为准。
- 新建 change 走 CLI 并使用响应路径；拒绝后按信息中的命令或目标修正并重试；自定义 Hook、非 Comet 工作和普通同名文件保持中立。
- Builder 提交本轮待验收的代码和相关文件，称为“候选实现”。Verify 覆盖全部验收项，复用仍与当前候选匹配的检查，只补缺失或失效证据。当前 Action 的 `sessionRequirements.independent` 为 `false` 时，由当前 Agent 根据不确定性和用户要求决定是否另请只读 Verifier；为 `true` 时使用独立会话。失败、阻塞、未执行和超时不能算通过。
- 只有用户明确确认完整 Shape、接受最终结果或选择相应交付方式后，才执行对应的确认命令。沿用已确认的需求范围和 Runtime 保存的用户选择。归档、merge、push、PR 和工作区清理各自需要的授权不能互相代替。
- Native 主流程由本 Skill 和 Runtime 完成，不依赖外部 Skill；不改变已确认的需求和约束时，实现方法由 Agent 自行选择。

## 开始或恢复

首次开始任务或更换 Agent 平台时，核对公开 CLI 和结果回报能力。当前 Action 要求独立会话时，再读取[平台能力核对](../comet/reference/host-check.md)并安排执行者。

1. 当前响应已包含工作区、任务和下一步时直接继续。缺少这些信息时，已知名称运行 `comet native select <change-name> --json`，否则运行 `comet native status --json`。active change 已存在时进入 `workspace.projectRoot`；工作区有歧义时才让用户选择。Run 记录丢失时读取[故障恢复](reference/recovery.md#故障恢复)。
2. 没有对应 active change 时，按[工作区选择参考](reference/workspace.md#创建-change)确定隔离方式，运行 `native new`，用 `--task` 传入用户原始请求，不先改写成方案摘要，再进入 `preparation.projectRoot`。准备失败时，保留已创建的分支和目录，按返回的原因处理。
3. 进入工作区并取得 `phase` 后，按[记忆接入](reference/commands.md#记忆接入)获取适用上下文。进入新阶段、交接给新 Agent 或恢复上下文时，由接收方执行 `contextRequest`，重新取得当前适用偏好和项目约束；同一阶段连续执行无需重复获取。任务结束时按该节分别处理项目记忆和个人记忆，再调用 `comet task --complete`。

仅在出现明确的用户纠正、长期记忆要求或已验证的可复用经验时提交学习内容。普通收尾无需调用工具证明没有观察，也无需清空学习队列。任务摘要、进展、命令输出和测试结果不写入个人记忆。

项目经验与个人偏好分开保存：可由当前项目验证、且未来任务仍可复用的经验在任务结束前执行 `comet knowledge remember` 写入项目记忆；用户偏好和稳定协作习惯才进入个人记忆。两者的命令和完成条件见[记忆接入](reference/commands.md#记忆接入)。

## SDK Run 路径

先读取并执行[普通命令与检查](../comet/reference/platform-execution.md)。旧业务数据自动适配，沿用原 Run 和有效批准。普通任务和 Supervisor 任务使用 `native next <change> --session <真实会话标识> --json` 领取。Shape 中由 Agent 提取验收条目并提交，等待用户明确确认后进入 Build。响应 `comet.native.task-result.v1` 给出阶段、实际工作区、验收正文、结果模板和下一步，直接照此执行。多个任务可领取时，从 `availableTasks` 选择真实执行范围，并用其 Action 和实际会话领取；按 `task.child`、`task.scope` 和工作区完成当前任务。

1. Builder 完成实现后，将 `resultTemplate` 的实际业务结果写入临时 UTF-8 JSON，用返回的 `next.commandArgs` 提交。保留命令中的 `--action` 和真实 `--session`。Agent 使用平台工具运行必要检查，等待真实结果，并在 checks 的 name/result/note 中记录命令、目录、结果和日志引用。Builder 一次回报实现与检查；Verifier 的 output.checks 填写本次采信的实际结果。失败、未运行和未知结果不能算通过，不提交 verificationChecks、request-checks 或自制收据。旧检查调度不再执行，使用当前返回的业务模板。当前会话继续验收时使用 `--review current-session`，另请审查者时使用 `--review independent`，由接收者以自己的真实会话领取。
2. Verify 覆盖全部验收项，复用有效检查，只补缺失证据；提交实际结论后，Runtime 返回用户接受结果的步骤。用户明确要求独立审查时必须选择独立会话。
3. 只有用户事前明确委托“验收通过后接受并归档”时，才在本次 Verify 回报中加 `--accept-on-pass <用户授权摘要>`。该摘要绑定本次通过结果。其他情况等待用户接受，再执行返回的确认命令。Git 交付仍使用已有的对应授权。

新建内置任务无需读取底层协议。并行子任务只在各自 worktree 工作并返回结果；主 Agent 按原 Action、真实子会话和领取身份顺序提交，保留原 `resultTemplate` 或 `resultRequest`，不重新领取或改用主会话。Supervisor 回报后，Runtime 连续处理 Git 集成和子归档；接收下一个子任务需使用其真实执行会话。父级验收保留全部要求，复用适用的子结果并补足集成缺口。当前响应为旧 `comet.native.sdk-status.v1`、`comet.native.dispatch-result.v1`、`comet.native.run-view.v1`，且高层入口不适用，或属于固定应用时，读取[SDK Run 命令与恢复](reference/commands.md#sdk-run)。完整协议需要时用 `--details`，不额外查询 status 来识别已有响应。

两种 Runtime 均使用最新 `continuation`；`--runner-input` 和旧 Archive 输入仅用于旧 Runtime。SDK 路径遵守用户确认、当前 Action 的验收要求和工作区授权。已知旧 change 在入口自动适配业务数据，不恢复旧进程或重播外部操作。

## 按需读取

只读取当前动作对应的章节。章节中的链接写明了适用条件，满足条件时再读取链接内容；不一次加载整份命令参考或所有参考。

- Shape：必须读取并执行[澄清](reference/clarification.md#澄清)，按项目配置选择 Sequential 或 Batch 的提问步骤。大型需求在最终确认前，必须按该节链接读取 Supervisor 拆分与确认要求。
- 编辑 brief/Spec/`children.yaml` 或核对验收报告前，必须读取[正式产物](reference/artifacts.md#正式产物)。文件、附件、链接或本地路径作为需求来源时，必须进入[源文档完整覆盖模式](reference/artifacts.md#源文档完整覆盖)；仅用于排错、取证、审查或实现参考的材料不自动触发。
- 高层任务响应缺少所需字段，或使用旧 SDK、固定应用时，读取[平台 Action 协议](reference/commands.md#sdk-action-领取与回报)、[SDK Builder 交接](reference/commands.md#sdk-builder-交接)或[SDK Verify 协议](reference/commands.md#sdk-verify-协议)中当前需要的章节。
- Compat 首次填写 Runner 模板或通过 `returnAction` 回传前，读取[填写命令输入](reference/commands.md#填写命令输入)，再按阶段读取[Builder 交接](reference/commands.md#builder-交接)或[Verify 协议](reference/commands.md#verify-协议)。
- 状态包含 `childSummary` 时，必须在分配任务、接收结果或集成前读取[Supervisor 协作](reference/commands.md#supervisor-协作)，只处理 `readyChildren` 列出的子任务和 Supervisor 统筹动作。
- 字段含义不清、命令输入被拒绝、Verifier 不可用、执行错误或缺少外部信息：读取[命令输入与异常](reference/commands.md#命令输入与异常)。正常动作直接使用 Runtime 返回的命令和模板。
- 等待外部输入时，按恢复参考中的[等待外部输入与监控](reference/recovery.md#等待外部输入与监控)处理；独立工作继续。进程中断、换设备、连续无进展、并发冲突、迁移失败或状态损坏时，读取[故障恢复](reference/recovery.md#故障恢复)。

## Shape

Agent 先调查能够查明的事实，只询问会改变用户可见结果、又无法可靠推断的决定。简单问题列出未决项及其依赖关系；多个决定相互影响时才建立决策树。按 `native.clarification_mode` 提问前，先把本轮尚未解决的问题写入 brief。用户确认的结论立即同步到 brief 的相关章节和完整目标规格；未明确回答的部分保持 `[blocking]`。

把用户明确指定的文件位置、必需章节和产物格式写入 brief 的约束，按原要求准备这些内容；不能因模板默认位置而改放其他文件。交接和恢复时以这些已确认约束核对产物，不能只保留业务示例。

写完 Shape 后，回到原始请求和公开项目资料核对目标、验收项与非目标。把实现必需的行为列为非目标前，先说明它会怎样改变用户要求；有多种解释时，写清依据和影响，不把自行选择的解释当作用户已确认的要求。固定评估任务中的模拟批准不能修改原题。

完成标准：需求来源已在用户指定的覆盖边界内完整处理并按用途分类，所有影响结果的决定和假设已处理，没有 `[blocking]`，用户明确确认目标、范围、关键决定、全部验收项和非目标，并且 Runtime 已进入 Build。

新建需求或重新确认 Shape 时，由 Agent 判断目标、范围、非目标、验收和必要 Spec 是否充分，按任务需要组织文档。Runtime 保留正式路径、非空输入、机器结构和用户确认检查。新建普通 SDK Run 可通过 `next --session` 提交明确验收条目，不要求为解析器改写文档。

Build、Verify 或待归档阶段发生编辑时，按[编辑后续行](reference/edit-review.md)由当前 Agent 判断影响，沿用原 Run 和有效批准，只补必要检查。文件变化不自动作废验收，不提交指纹、hash 或编辑复核记录。修订命令不构成用户授权；缺授权时只请求受影响的决定。

## Build ↔ Verify Loop

Builder 完成实现并用平台工具执行检查后，一次提交候选与实际结果，再由领取 Verify Action 的 Agent 完成验收。未通过则回 Build 修复并重新提交；全部通过后，等待用户接受验收结果。

Verifier 先读原始请求，再对照 Spec 和实现，核对有无遗漏、未经授权的范围缩减或接口行为变化。SDK Run 使用同一份验收结果中的 `requestReview` 说明结论；有冲突或仍影响交付的疑问时，保留 fail 或 blocked。旧 Run 和 Compat 没有保存原始请求时，从交接材料和用户记录补查，不把新生成的 Spec 当成唯一需求来源；Compat 沿用原结果结构。语义核对沿用当前 Verifier，不增加 Agent 或固定测试轮次。

`iteration` 表示提交实现的轮次，`attempt` 表示同一候选的 Verifier 执行次数。Runtime 保留真实失败次数预算和执行上限；Agent 根据实际修改和结果判断进展。未解决验收项 ID 相同或集合未缩小，不触发额外提示、暂停或重新确认。

## Build

首次实现前，读取当前 brief、完整目标规格和全部验收项，在已确认的需求范围内修改项目代码和测试。修复时优先处理 Verifier 指出的未通过项、无法验证的原因和失败检查；提交前仍要核对其他已确认行为。`previous_unresolved_ids` 只提示本轮修复重点，下一次正式验收仍覆盖全部验收项。

Build、Verify 和 Archive 由 Agent 对照实际文件和用户要求判断变化，不以内容摘要决定批准或验收是否失效。需求未变则保留批准，目标、验收标准或授权发生实质变化且原决定未覆盖时才重新确认。正式产物位置和阶段权限见[正式产物](reference/artifacts.md#正式产物)。

用户 Hook 的共享输出目录可通过 `.comet/config.yaml` 的 `hook.allow_paths` 放行；该配置对 Native 和 Classic 共用，工作流产物目录不在白名单范围。详见[用户 Hook 写入](reference/commands.md#用户-hook-写入)。

需求变化时，先判断变化属于哪种情况，再执行当前 `continuation` 允许的动作：

- 已确认的功能有实现遗漏：从 Verify 使用 `--revise-implementation`，保留已确认的需求范围，回 Build 修改。
- 用户可见行为或验收标准发生变化：从 Verify 或 Archive-ready 使用 `--revise-requirements`，更新正式文件，按[需求变化后的重新确认](reference/clarification.md#需求变化后的重新确认)先说明变化与影响，再展示完整当前 Shape 并重新确认。
- 与当前需求无关：交给另一个 change。

用户明确补充当前范围时，按同一规则处理。

用户确认一次 Supervisor Shape，就授权执行该范围内的全部子任务。按 Runtime 的指令分配和集成子任务，随后自动进行 Supervisor 主任务的最终验收，覆盖全部验收项。按[Supervisor 协作](reference/commands.md#supervisor-协作)区分统筹、Builder 和 Verifier 的职责；只有 Runtime 接受了子任务的验收结果并确认集成成功，才算完成。

提交候选前，按 brief 中登记的原位置检查文件、章节和格式，补齐遗漏产物；Agent 选择适用的自动检查，用平台工具检查原文件的实际内容，并记录检查对象和结果；不能用另一文件中的同类内容代替。修改已批准正式内容时沿用现有修订和确认流程。

完成标准：实现和相关检查可供验收，Runtime 接受 Builder 交接并进入 Verify。

## Verify

新 SDK 普通任务按当前 `task` 和 `resultTemplate` 完成验收；Builder 回报已包含内部检查与领取时，直接继续本次任务。旧 SDK 按 [SDK Verify 协议](reference/commands.md#sdk-verify-协议) 与 `sessionRequirements.independent` 领取，优先使用 `resultRequest`，缺少时使用 `outcomeRequest`。所有执行者使用真实会话身份。

Compat 按 [Verify 协议](reference/commands.md#verify-协议) 立即启动新的只读 Verifier，原样传递任务包。派发只代表登记：平台接受启动调用、且 Verifier 回报 `verifier-started` 后，才说明它已运行；启动失败立即按异常流程处理。任务包含验收正文时直接使用，否则按分页读取全部 scopeIds。

Verifier 独立判断全部验收项，同时核对 brief 中登记的产物位置、必需章节和格式，不能用另一文件中的同类内容代替；缺项或错位时报告实际差异，不能给当前候选通过结论。由验收者判断已有真实检查是否仍适用，只补必要证据；新旧 Run 均通过平台工具执行检查；文件和日志正文按需读取。等待工具超时后，继续等待同一个 Verifier。只有平台确认执行失败、超时、任务丢失或结束后无结果时才登记错误。Runtime 接受完整结果后按最新状态继续。

用户明确接受当前结果后执行 `--accept-result`。用户事前明确委托通过后接受并归档时，按上文使用带授权摘要的 `--accept-on-pass`；fail、blocked 和执行失败均不能触发接受。Compat 的接受与交付方式仍按当前备选命令处理。

完成标准：Runtime 接受每项验收结论并给出下一步；返回 Build 就继续修复，返回等待或阻塞就处理对应条件，不把阶段结束当任务完成。

## Archive

SDK 接受结果后由 Runtime 连续完成归档。响应已说明归档完成时直接核对用户授权的 Git 交付；返回 Archive 命令时执行该命令。只有 Compat 收尾、工作区交付选择或具体恢复要求不清时，才读取[Archive 收尾](reference/workspace.md#archive-收尾)。只处理当前响应列出的阻塞。

- Before editing the brief, Specs, or `children.yaml`, or checking an acceptance report, read [formal artifacts](reference/artifacts.md#formal-artifacts). - Read the relevant part of [SDK Action protocol](reference/commands.md#sdk-action-claims-and-outcomes), [SDK Builder handoff](reference/commands.md#sdk-builder-handoff), or [SDK Verify protocol](reference/commands.md#sdk-verify-protocol) when needed fields are missing or the task uses an older SDK Run or fixed application.
- Before first filling a Compat Runner template or returning through `returnAction`, read [filling command inputs](reference/commands.md#filling-command-inputs), then the applicable [Builder handoff](reference/commands.md#builder-handoff) or [Verify protocol](reference/commands.md#verify-protocol).

- When waiting for external input, follow [external input and monitoring](reference/recovery.md#external-input-and-monitoring); continue independent work. ## Shape

Investigate facts that can be established without the user. Ask only about decisions that change user-visible outcomes and cannot be inferred reliably. For simple requests, list unresolved questions and dependencies; maintain a decision tree only when several decisions affect one another. Before asking under `native.clarification_mode`, save this round's unresolved questions in the brief. Immediately copy confirmed conclusions into the relevant brief sections and complete target Specs. Keep unanswered parts `[blocking]`.

Record the user's explicitly requested file locations, required sections, and artifact formats in the brief constraints, and prepare those contents as requested. Do not move them to another file because of a default location in a template. During handoff and recovery, check artifacts against these confirmed constraints rather than retaining only the business examples.

After drafting Shape, compare its outcome, acceptance criteria and non-goals with the original request and public project materials. Before excluding behavior needed by the implementation, explain how that changes the requested outcome. When several interpretations remain possible, state the evidence and impact; an Agent's chosen interpretation is not a user-confirmed requirement. Simulated approval in a fixed benchmark cannot change the original task.

Complete when requirements sources are fully processed within the coverage boundary and classified by purpose, all outcome-affecting decisions and assumptions are resolved, no `[blocking]` remains, the user explicitly confirms the outcome, scope, key decisions, all acceptance items, and non-goals, and Runtime has entered Build.

For new or reconfirmed Shape, the Agent judges whether goals, scope, non-goals, acceptance, and necessary Specs are sufficient and organizes documents for the task. Runtime checks formal paths, nonempty inputs, machine structure, and user confirmation. New ordinary SDK Runs can submit explicit criteria through `next --session` without rewriting prose for a parser.

When files change during Build, Verify, or before Archive, the current Agent follows [edit continuation](reference/edit-review.md), judges the actual impact, and retains the original Run and valid approvals. Revision commands do not grant user authorization; request only the affected decision when authorization is missing.

## Build ↔ Verify Loop

The Builder implements and runs checks with platform tools, then submits the candidate and actual results together. The Agent claiming Verify evaluates acceptance. On failure, return to Build, repair, and resubmit. Once every item passes, wait for the user to accept the result.

The Verifier reads the original request before comparing the Spec and implementation, checking for omissions, unauthorized scope reductions and interface behavior changes. SDK Runs record the conclusion in `requestReview` in the same verification result; retain fail or blocked for conflicts or unresolved questions affecting delivery. For older Runs and Compat without a saved original request, consult handoff materials and user records rather than treating the generated Spec as the only requirements source; Compat keeps its existing result format. Use the current Verifier for this semantic review; add no Agent or fixed test rounds.

`iteration` counts implementation submissions; `attempt` counts Verifier executions for one candidate. Runtime retains actual failure budgets and execution limits. The Agent judges progress from changes and results. Repeated unresolved IDs or a nonshrinking set do not add warnings, pauses, or confirmation steps.

Before the first implementation, read the current brief, complete target Specs, and every acceptance item. Edit project code and tests within confirmed scope. During repair, prioritize the Verifier's failed or blocked items and failed checks, then recheck other confirmed behavior before submission. `previous_unresolved_ids` identifies the repair focus; the next formal verification still covers every acceptance item.

Build, Verify, and Archive recheck the binding between formal files and the approved original text. When something changes, the current Agent judges its semantics and impact; an unchanged contract keeps its approval, and only a material change to the goal, acceptance criteria, or authorization requests the related decision. After an edit, Hooks verify actual content before the next implementation write or advancement, and the verification also runs when a Hook did not fire. Existing Shapes retain their binding; invalid documents or reports preserve work and address only the specific gaps. Ordinary documents preserve candidates by default; use `native.document_writes: revert` for strict behavior. See [formal artifacts](reference/artifacts.md#formal-artifacts) for paths.

- Missing implementation of confirmed functionality: use `--revise-implementation` from Verify, retain confirmed scope, and return to Build.
- Changed user-visible behavior or acceptance criteria: use `--revise-requirements` from Verify or Archive-ready, update formal artifacts, and follow [reconfirmation after requirement changes](reference/clarification.md#reconfirmation-after-requirement-changes) to explain changes and effects before presenting and reconfirming the complete current Shape.
- Unrelated requirements: use another change.

Apply the same rules when the user explicitly adds to the current scope.

One confirmed Supervisor Shape authorizes all children within that scope. Dispatch and integrate as Runtime directs, then automatically perform final verification of every Supervisor acceptance item. Follow [Supervisor coordination](reference/commands.md#supervisor-coordination) for coordinator, Builder, and Verifier responsibilities. A child is complete only after Runtime accepts its verification and confirms integration.

Before submitting a candidate, check files, sections, and formats at the original locations recorded in the brief, and complete missing artifacts. Add requirements that can be checked automatically to the current Runtime check plan, checking their actual contents rather than only finding equivalent content in another file. Follow the existing revision and confirmation flow when changing approved formal content.

For new ordinary SDK tasks, follow the current `task` and `resultTemplate`. When Builder submission already ran checks and claimed Verify, continue that task directly. Every executor uses its actual session identity.

For Compat, immediately launch a new read-only Verifier under [Verify protocol](reference/commands.md#verify-protocol), passing the unchanged task package. Dispatch alone is registration: report running only after the platform accepts startup and the Verifier reports `verifier-started`. Handle startup failures immediately. Use inline acceptance text or page through every scopeId.

The Verifier independently assesses all acceptance items and checks the artifact locations, required sections, and formats recorded in the brief. Equivalent content in another file does not satisfy these requirements; report missing or misplaced content and do not pass the current candidate. The reviewer judges whether actual existing checks still apply and adds necessary evidence. New v4 Runs use platform tools for checks; older Runs retain their Runtime check protocol. Read files and logs on demand. After a wait-tool timeout, keep waiting for the same Verifier. Record errors only for platform-confirmed failure, execution timeout, task loss, or completion without a usable result. Continue from current state after Runtime accepts the complete outcome.

Run `--accept-result` after explicit user acceptance of the current result. If the user previously delegated acceptance and Archive after a pass, use `--accept-on-pass` with that authorization summary as described above. Fail, blocked, and execution failures cannot trigger acceptance. Compat retains its returned acceptance and delivery alternatives.

Complete when Runtime accepts each verdict and supplies the next action. Continue repairs on Build, or address the specified waiting or blocking condition. Ending a phase does not mean the task is finished.

After SDK result acceptance, Runtime advances through Archive. If the response already reports completion, proceed to Git delivery under its existing authorization. Otherwise execute the returned Archive command. Read [Archive completion](reference/workspace.md#archive-completion) only for Compat finishing, workspace delivery choices, or an unclear recovery requirement. Address the blockers in the current response.

Commit only this change's implementation and formal artifacts; preserve unrelated edits. For Compat, inspect `workspaceFinishResult`, preserving the workspace and following `recoveryArgs` if blocked; for SDK, verify Run archival and actual Git delivery separately. Fix commit messages and local blockers under existing authorization and continue; ask only for new authorization or external information.

Complete when state is `done`; SDK Run is `completed` and authorized Git delivery has actually completed and been verified, or Compat workspace finishing is `completed` or `kept`; then record completion through memory integration. Continue handling any other result.

## Continuation

When the response includes `continuation.mode`, use it to decide the current action: `execute` uses the complete returned arguments, input templates, and task package; `wait` waits for the original task; `ask` presents the current proposal and awaits the user decision; `reconcile` checks the original execution or addresses blockers using the returned evidence; `done` ends after checking the criteria for this completion or cancellation. Fill `commandArgs` placeholders using `requiredInputs` and the input templates; a template is neither completed input nor user approval. `inputRef` points to complete input in the same response; read it without querying state again. After each write, use only the new response’s identity, version, and working directory. When details are essential, use the retrieval command in that response rather than querying to discover the next step.

For older responses without `mode`, use the original `disposition`:

- `continue`: execute the complete `commandArgs` in the returned working directory and fill inputs from `inputOptions` templates.
- `await-user`: relay `userCommunication.message` and `suggestedReply`, then wait for the listed decisions. Execute the matching `commandAlternatives`, retaining `--expected-state-version` and `--expected-action`. Read the latest state if stale; do not construct an unguarded command.
- `blocked`: address listed blockers or recovery actions; pause only dependent work.
- `done`: finish after checking the Archive completion criteria.

After a successful response containing `agent`, reuse the shared workflow guard's lightweight ownership result and continue with the response's phase, state version, `workspace.cwd`, and `continuation`. Read details only when fields are missing, the command is rejected for version or ownership, or the action needs additional artifact text. Query `status` again only for a new session or compression recovery without response state, a repository/branch/change switch, or clear external changes. Do not redispatch an existing Verifier or child task because a wait tool timed out.

Add `--details` only when the current action needs acceptance text, handoff summaries, or history. Follow `nextPageArgs` through every page covering `scopeIds`. Run `show` only when artifact bodies are needed. For CLI text, read `summary`, the single `NEXT:`, and any relay message first. Use `--json` for programmatic parsing and `--verbose` only to diagnose local execution.

## Optional change walkthrough

For Native, generate `walkthrough.html` only when the user requests a visual change explanation. The project setting `change_walkthrough` is enabled by default; explicit `false` skips generation. When enabled and requested, read [Change walkthrough](../comet/reference/change-walkthrough.md), reuse existing differences and results, generate or update the same page, and provide its link. Ordinary completion uses a short summary. Archive preserves existing pages and links to their archived location without generating missing pages, adding confirmation, or rerunning checks for page updates.

New built-in tasks do not require the lower-level protocol. Parallel children work only in their own worktrees and return results. The parent submits them in sequence with the original Action, actual child session, and claim identity, preserving the original `resultTemplate` or `resultRequest`; do not reclaim the task or substitute the parent session. After Supervisor results, Runtime continues Git integration and Child Archive; receive the next child with its actual execution session. Parent acceptance retains all requirements, reuses applicable child results, and fills integration gaps. Read [SDK Run commands and recovery](reference/commands.md#sdk-run) for older `comet.native.sdk-status.v1`, `comet.native.dispatch-result.v1`, or `comet.native.run-view.v1` responses where the high-level entry does not apply, fixed applications, or a specific protocol question. Use `--details` when needed. Do not query status again to identify an existing response.

Both runtimes use the latest `continuation`; `--runner-input` and legacy Archive inputs apply only to the legacy Runtime. SDK requires approval, the current Action's verification conditions, and workspace authorization. Known legacy changes are adapted at their entry without recovering processes or replaying external operations.

## Read only what the action needs

Read the section for the current action. Follow links within it only when their stated conditions apply; do not load the entire command reference or all references at once.

- Shape: read and follow [clarification](reference/clarification.md#clarification), using Sequential or Batch steps according to project configuration. For large requests, follow its Supervisor decomposition and confirmation link before final confirmation.
- Before editing the brief, Specs, or `children.yaml`, or checking an acceptance report, read [formal artifacts](reference/artifacts.md#formal-artifacts). A file, attachment, link, or local path supplied as a requirements source requires [source-document full coverage](reference/artifacts.md#source-document-full-coverage). Material used only for debugging, evidence gathering, review, or implementation reference does not trigger this automatically.
- Read the relevant part of [SDK Action protocol](reference/commands.md#sdk-action-claims-and-outcomes), [SDK Builder handoff](reference/commands.md#sdk-builder-handoff), or [SDK Verify protocol](reference/commands.md#sdk-verify-protocol) when needed fields are missing or the task uses an older SDK Run or fixed application.
- Before first filling a Compat Runner template or returning through `returnAction`, read [filling command inputs](reference/commands.md#filling-command-inputs), then the applicable [Builder handoff](reference/commands.md#builder-handoff) or [Verify protocol](reference/commands.md#verify-protocol).
- When state contains `childSummary`, read [Supervisor coordination](reference/commands.md#supervisor-coordination) before dispatching, receiving results, or integrating. Handle only children listed in `readyChildren` and Supervisor coordination actions.
- If fields are unclear, input is rejected, a Verifier is unavailable, execution fails, or external information is missing, read [command inputs and exceptions](reference/commands.md#command-inputs-and-exceptions). For normal actions, use Runtime's returned commands and templates directly.
- When waiting for external input, follow [external input and monitoring](reference/recovery.md#external-input-and-monitoring); continue independent work. For interruption, a device change, repeated lack of progress, concurrency conflicts, failed migration, or damaged state, read [fault recovery](reference/recovery.md#fault-recovery).

## Shape

Investigate facts that can be established without the user. Ask only about decisions that change user-visible outcomes and cannot be inferred reliably. For simple requests, list unresolved questions and dependencies; maintain a decision tree only when several decisions affect one another. Before asking under `native.clarification_mode`, save this round's unresolved questions in the brief. Immediately copy confirmed conclusions into the relevant brief sections and complete target Specs. Keep unanswered parts `[blocking]`.

Record the user's explicitly requested file locations, required sections, and artifact formats in the brief constraints, and prepare those contents as requested. Do not move them to another file because of a default location in a template. During handoff and recovery, check artifacts against these confirmed constraints rather than retaining only the business examples.

After drafting Shape, compare its outcome, acceptance criteria and non-goals with the original request and public project materials. Before excluding behavior needed by the implementation, explain how that changes the requested outcome. When several interpretations remain possible, state the evidence and impact; an Agent's chosen interpretation is not a user-confirmed requirement. Simulated approval in a fixed benchmark cannot change the original task.

Complete when requirements sources are fully processed within the coverage boundary and classified by purpose, all outcome-affecting decisions and assumptions are resolved, no `[blocking]` remains, the user explicitly confirms the outcome, scope, key decisions, all acceptance items, and non-goals, and Runtime has entered Build.

For new or reconfirmed Shape, the Agent judges whether goals, scope, non-goals, acceptance, and necessary Specs are sufficient and organizes documents for the task. Runtime checks formal paths, nonempty inputs, machine structure, and user confirmation. New ordinary SDK Runs can submit explicit criteria through `next --session` without rewriting prose for a parser.

When files change during Build, Verify, or before Archive, the current Agent follows [edit continuation](reference/edit-review.md), judges the actual impact, and retains the original Run and valid approvals. File edits do not automatically invalidate acceptance. Do not submit fingerprints, content hashes, or edit-review records. Add only the checks that the changed behavior needs. Revision commands do not grant user authorization; request only the affected decision when authorization is missing.

## Build ↔ Verify Loop

The Builder implements and runs checks with platform tools, then submits the candidate and actual results together. The Agent claiming Verify evaluates acceptance. On failure, return to Build, repair, and resubmit. Once every item passes, wait for the user to accept the result.

The Verifier reads the original request before comparing the Spec and implementation, checking for omissions, unauthorized scope reductions and interface behavior changes. SDK Runs record the conclusion in `requestReview` in the same verification result; retain fail or blocked for conflicts or unresolved questions affecting delivery. For older Runs and Compat without a saved original request, consult handoff materials and user records rather than treating the generated Spec as the only requirements source; Compat keeps its existing result format. Use the current Verifier for this semantic review; add no Agent or fixed test rounds.

`iteration` counts implementation submissions; `attempt` counts Verifier executions for one candidate. Runtime retains actual failure budgets and execution limits. The Agent judges progress from changes and results. Repeated unresolved IDs or a nonshrinking set do not add warnings, pauses, or confirmation steps.

## Build

Before the first implementation, read the current brief, complete target Specs, and every acceptance item. Edit project code and tests within confirmed scope. During repair, prioritize the Verifier's failed or blocked items and failed checks, then recheck other confirmed behavior before submission. `previous_unresolved_ids` identifies the repair focus; the next formal verification still covers every acceptance item.

Build, Verify, and Archive recheck the binding between formal files and the approved original text. When something changes, the current Agent judges its semantics and impact; an unchanged contract keeps its approval, and only a material change to the goal, acceptance criteria, or authorization requests the related decision. After an edit, Hooks verify actual content before the next implementation write or advancement, and the verification also runs when a Hook did not fire. Existing Shapes retain their binding; invalid documents or reports preserve work and address only the specific gaps. Ordinary documents preserve candidates by default; use `native.document_writes: revert` for strict behavior. See [formal artifacts](reference/artifacts.md#formal-artifacts) for paths.

User Hook output can use `hook.allow_paths` in `.comet/config.yaml`; see [User Hook writes](reference/commands.md#user-hook-writes).

Classify requirement changes before taking an action allowed by the current `continuation`:

- Missing implementation of confirmed functionality: use `--revise-implementation` from Verify, retain confirmed scope, and return to Build.
- Changed user-visible behavior or acceptance criteria: use `--revise-requirements` from Verify or Archive-ready, update formal artifacts, and follow [reconfirmation after requirement changes](reference/clarification.md#reconfirmation-after-requirement-changes) to explain changes and effects before presenting and reconfirming the complete current Shape.
- Unrelated requirements: use another change.

Apply the same rules when the user explicitly adds to the current scope.

One confirmed Supervisor Shape authorizes all children within that scope. Dispatch and integrate as Runtime directs, then automatically perform final verification of every Supervisor acceptance item. Follow [Supervisor coordination](reference/commands.md#supervisor-coordination) for coordinator, Builder, and Verifier responsibilities. A child is complete only after Runtime accepts its verification and confirms integration.

Before submitting a candidate, check files, sections, and formats at the original locations recorded in the brief, and complete missing artifacts. The Agent chooses applicable automated checks, runs them with platform tools against the original files' actual contents, and records the check targets and results; equivalent content in another file does not replace those checks. Follow the existing revision and confirmation flow when changing approved formal content.

Complete when the implementation and relevant checks are ready for verification, Runtime accepts the Builder handoff, and the phase is Verify.

## Verify

For new ordinary SDK tasks, follow the current `task` and `resultTemplate`. When Builder submission already ran checks and claimed Verify, continue that task directly. Older SDK Runs use [SDK Verify protocol](reference/commands.md#sdk-verify-protocol), follow `sessionRequirements.independent`, and prefer `resultRequest`, falling back to `outcomeRequest` when absent. Every executor uses its actual session identity.

For Compat, immediately launch a new read-only Verifier under [Verify protocol](reference/commands.md#verify-protocol), passing the unchanged task package. Dispatch alone is registration: report running only after the platform accepts startup and the Verifier reports `verifier-started`. Handle startup failures immediately. Use inline acceptance text or page through every scopeId.

The Verifier independently assesses all acceptance items and checks the artifact locations, required sections, and formats recorded in the brief. Equivalent content in another file does not satisfy these requirements; report missing or misplaced content and do not pass the current candidate. The reviewer judges whether actual existing checks still apply and adds necessary evidence. New v4 Runs use platform tools for checks; older Runs retain their Runtime check protocol. Read files and logs on demand. After a wait-tool timeout, keep waiting for the same Verifier. Record errors only for platform-confirmed failure, execution timeout, task loss, or completion without a usable result. Continue from current state after Runtime accepts the complete outcome.

Run `--accept-result` after explicit user acceptance of the current result. If the user previously delegated acceptance and Archive after a pass, use `--accept-on-pass` with that authorization summary as described above. Fail, blocked, and execution failures cannot trigger acceptance. Compat retains its returned acceptance and delivery alternatives.

Complete when Runtime accepts each verdict and supplies the next action. Continue repairs on Build, or address the specified waiting or blocking condition. Ending a phase does not mean the task is finished.

## Archive

After SDK result acceptance, Runtime advances through Archive. If the response already reports completion, proceed to Git delivery under its existing authorization. Otherwise execute the returned Archive command. Read [Archive completion](reference/workspace.md#archive-completion) only for Compat finishing, workspace delivery choices, or an unclear recovery requirement. Address the blockers in the current response.

Commit only this change's implementation and formal artifacts; preserve unrelated edits. For Compat, inspect `workspaceFinishResult`, preserving the workspace and following `recoveryArgs` if blocked; for SDK, verify Run archival and actual Git delivery separately. Fix commit messages and local blockers under existing authorization and continue; ask only for new authorization or external information.

Complete when state is `done`; SDK Run is `completed` and authorized Git delivery has actually completed and been verified, or Compat workspace finishing is `completed` or `kept`; then record completion through memory integration. Continue handling any other result.

## Continuation

When the response includes `continuation.mode`, use it to decide the current action: `execute` uses the complete returned arguments, input templates, and task package; `wait` waits for the original task; `ask` presents the current proposal and awaits the user decision; `reconcile` checks the original execution or addresses blockers using the returned evidence; `done` ends after checking the criteria for this completion or cancellation. Fill `commandArgs` placeholders using `requiredInputs` and the input templates; a template is neither completed input nor user approval. `inputRef` points to complete input in the same response; read it without querying state again. After each write, use only the new response’s identity, version, and working directory. When details are essential, use the retrieval command in that response rather than querying to discover the next step.

For older responses without `mode`, use the original `disposition`:

- `continue`: execute the complete `commandArgs` in the returned working directory and fill inputs from `inputOptions` templates.
- `await-user`: relay `userCommunication.message` and `suggestedReply`, then wait for the listed decisions. Execute the matching `commandAlternatives`, retaining `--expected-state-version` and `--expected-action`. Read the latest state if stale; do not construct an unguarded command.
- `blocked`: address listed blockers or recovery actions; pause only dependent work.
- `done`: finish after checking the Archive completion criteria.

After a successful response containing `agent`, reuse the shared workflow guard's lightweight ownership result and continue with the response's phase, state version, `workspace.cwd`, and `continuation`. Read details only when fields are missing, the command is rejected for version or ownership, or the action needs additional artifact text. Query `status` again only for a new session or compression recovery without response state, a repository/branch/change switch, or clear external changes. Do not redispatch an existing Verifier or child task because a wait tool timed out.

Add `--details` only when the current action needs acceptance text, handoff summaries, or history. Follow `nextPageArgs` through every page covering `scopeIds`. Run `show` only when artifact bodies are needed. For CLI text, read `summary`, the single `NEXT:`, and any relay message first. Use `--json` for programmatic parsing and `--verbose` only to diagnose local execution.

## Optional change walkthrough

For Native, generate `walkthrough.html` only when the user requests a visual change explanation. The project setting `change_walkthrough` is enabled by default; explicit `false` skips generation. When enabled and requested, read [Change walkthrough](../comet/reference/change-walkthrough.md), reuse existing differences and results, generate or update the same page, and provide its link. Ordinary completion uses a short summary. Archive preserves existing pages and links to their archived location without generating missing pages, adding confirmation, or rerunning checks for page updates.
